title: Director of Marketing

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: Owns go-to-market strategy, competitive positioning, and customer messaging for Ultraflex's product portfolio. With active participation at ISA Sign Expo and PRINTING United (including an 80s arcade-themed booth at 2025 expo), this role is responsible for differentiating Ultraflex in a crowded large-format printing substrate market. Tedlar provides compelling marketing ammunition: the ability to claim industry-leading 12-20+ year outdoor durability vs. their current 1-3 year materials transforms their value proposition from commodity pricing battles to premium quality leadership. This role cares about: (1) competitive differentiation messaging that justifies higher pricing, (2) reducing negative customer feedback and warranty claims that damage brand reputation, (3) positioning products for premium architectural and transit segments (building wraps, transit interiors) where Tedlar's extreme durability unlocks new market opportunities, and (4) trade show storytelling—being able to showcase UV protection, graffiti resistance, and 20-year performance creates powerful booth demonstrations and sales collateral for their ISA/PRINTING United presence.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: As Director of Marketing, [Name] owns competitive positioning, product messaging, go-to-market strategy, and customer-facing communications for Ultraflex's entire substrate portfolio. They drive trade show strategy and booth presence at ISA Sign Expo and PRINTING United, manage product launch campaigns (like the recent VorTex Soft Signage expansion), and develop messaging that differentiates Ultraflex's products in the crowded large-format printing market. While they don't make final product formulation decisions, they influence product strategy by communicating market needs and competitive gaps to product development. They report to senior leadership (likely CMO or CEO) and collaborate closely with sales, product development, and operations teams.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Tedlar overlaminates directly address Ultraflex's outdoor graphics portfolio gap—their building wraps, barricade graphics, fence graphics, and outdoor signage materials currently last 1-3 years outdoors, while Tedlar-protected products deliver 12-20+ years. For [Name], this transforms marketing positioning: instead of competing on price with commodity banner suppliers, they can claim industry-leading outdoor performance. Specific use cases that matter: (1) Building wraps and architectural graphics with Tedlar protection enable them to enter premium commercial real estate and municipal projects requiring multi-decade warranties, (2) Transit and fleet graphics with graffiti-resistant Tedlar solve vandalism concerns for transportation clients, (3) Outdoor signage overlaminates prevent the UV degradation, yellowing, and cracking complaints that currently damage customer relationships and limit repeat business in high-visibility installations.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] likely owns metrics around brand perception, competitive win rates, product launch success, trade show lead generation, and customer satisfaction/NPS scores. They personally care about solving: (1) Competitive differentiation—how to justify premium pricing and win against lower-cost competitors in RFPs, (2) Customer complaint volume—negative reviews about fading and weather damage directly undermine their marketing claims about 'harsh weather conditions' performance, (3) Market expansion—accessing higher-margin architectural and transit segments currently inaccessible with short-lifespan materials, (4) Trade show ROI—having compelling demonstrations and proof points (like Tedlar's UV resistance and graffiti cleanability) that draw booth traffic and convert leads at PRINTING United and ISA events. Tedlar's value propositions directly improve their ability to tell a premium quality story, reduce warranty-related brand damage, and create memorable trade show experiences.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Ultraflex is exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo 2025 on October 22-24 in Orlando with a fully built 80s arcade-themed booth environment—this represents significant marketing investment and a prime opportunity to showcase premium product innovations. They recently launched the VorTex Soft Signage line expansion with four new ReSource products in November 2025, demonstrating active product portfolio development. Their consistent presence at ISA Sign Expo (exhibited in 2023) indicates they're planning for future events. NOW is the ideal time to engage: they're in planning mode for their next major trade show presence, likely evaluating how to differentiate their booth messaging and product story, and the VorTex launch shows they're actively expanding premium product lines where Tedlar's performance story fits perfectly.

personalization_hooks.hook: Ultraflex's outdoor materials (building wraps, banners) currently last 1-3 years versus industry complaints about premature fading and weather damage
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as the solution to their biggest marketing challenge: turning 1-3 year outdoor materials into 12-20+ year premium products enables them to shift from price-based competition to quality leadership. Frame this as unlocking new messaging: 'What if your outdoor graphics lasted as long as the buildings they're on?'

personalization_hooks.hook: Ultraflex investing heavily in PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) with an 80s arcade-themed booth
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their trade show investment and suggest Tedlar demonstrations (UV resistance tests, graffiti cleanability) as booth attractions that align with their experiential marketing approach. Offer to discuss how Tedlar-protected samples could differentiate their booth presence and create shareable moments for attendees.

personalization_hooks.hook: Recent VorTex Soft Signage expansion with four new ReSource products shows active premium product line development
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Connect to their product innovation momentum—frame Tedlar as a strategic partner for their next product line evolution. Ask: 'As you expand VorTex and other premium lines, what if you could offer the only outdoor graphics with certified 20-year performance? How would that change your competitive positioning?'

recommended_approach: Lead with trade show momentum and competitive differentiation. Open by acknowledging their PRINTING United Expo investment and creative booth strategy, then pivot to the business challenge: how to stand out in a crowded substrate market. Position Tedlar not as a material supplier, but as a strategic marketing advantage that transforms their outdoor graphics story from commodity to premium. Offer a brief conversation about how other sign/graphics companies use Tedlar's extreme performance as trade show proof points and customer conversion tools.
